# Knowledge Compiler CLI

The Knowledge Compiler CLI (kc) provides a command-line interface for compiling engineering artifacts into a knowledge base. It supports various commands for initializing repositories, compiling data, reconciling changes, verifying states, inspecting entities, and validating tests against compiled knowledge.
